# Defender (Williams 1981) sprite data extracted from historicalsource/defender DEFB6.SRC / MESS0.SRC
# FORMAT: NAME  W_BYTES  H_PIX  | hex bytes
# Data is COLUMN-MAJOR: W_BYTES columns, each column H_PIX bytes top->bottom.
# Each byte = 2 horizontal pixels: HIGH nibble = LEFT pixel, LOW nibble = RIGHT pixel. Nibble = palette index 0-15 (0 = transparent).
# So sprite is (2*W_BYTES) px wide x H_PIX px tall. Name suffix 0 / 1 = two images (even/odd pixel alignment variants in
# the original; for a recreation, also treated as animation frames for some sprites e.g. landers/UFO).
# Palette index->colour: see graphics.md (CRTAB). 8-bit colour: bits0-2 R, 3-5 G, 6-7 B.
